title: Moroccan Mushroom Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan-inspired dish featuring sautéed mushrooms, spices, and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Button or cremini mushrooms work well

ingredients.name: Jazzy
ingredients.notes: Use jazzy spice blend or create your own mix

ingredients.name: Moroccan spices
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add jazzy spice blend and cook for another minute.
Stir in aerated sugar and cook for 30 seconds.
Add Moroccan spices and cook for 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
